evals.name: download-single-video
evals.prompt: 帮我把 http://127.0.0.1:8931/sample.mp4 这个视频下载到本地，输出目录用 {{OUTPUTS}}，保存成 mp4 文件。下载完成后告诉我文件保存到了哪里。
evals.expected_output: A .mp4 file downloaded into the outputs directory; the agent reports the final file path. Uses the video-download skill CLI.

assertions.name: mp4 file exists in outputs dir
assertions.description: A .mp4 file is present in the run's outputs directory

assertions.name: downloaded file is a real video (>50KB)
assertions.description: The downloaded mp4 is substantial, matching the 91KB sample — not an empty placeholder

evals.name: metadata-report
evals.prompt: 查一下 http://127.0.0.1:8931/sample.mp4 这个视频的信息：标题、时长、格式/分辨率情况。把结果整理成一份简短报告（Markdown），保存到 {{OUTPUTS}} 目录下，并在对话里总结关键信息。
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report file in outputs containing title, duration, and format/resolution info; conversation summary mentions key facts.

assertions.name: markdown report exists in outputs dir
assertions.description: A .md report file is present in the run's outputs directory

assertions.name: report contains duration info
assertions.description: Report mentions the video duration (~2 seconds)
assertions.check: report text contains duration marker (2s / 2 sec / 00:00:02)

evals.name: extract-audio
evals.prompt: 把 http://127.0.0.1:8931/sample.mp4 的音频提取出来转成 mp3，保存到 {{OUTPUTS}} 目录。
evals.expected_output: An .mp3 file in the outputs directory extracted from the sample video.

assertions.name: mp3 file exists in outputs dir
assertions.description: An .mp3 file is present in the run's outputs directory

assertions.name: mp3 file is real audio (>10KB)
assertions.description: The extracted mp3 is substantial (real extraction was 20KB) — not an empty placeholder
